Case :- Criminal Appeal No. - 8842 of 2023

Appellant :- Rajeshwari Devi
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 8 Others

Counsel for Appellant :- Akhilesh Kumar Tiwari,Rabindra Tiwari
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
List has been revised.
Heard Sri Akhilesh Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
Despite service of notice, no one appears on behalf of the opposite party Nos. 2 to 9.

This criminal appeal under Section 14-A (1) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (hereinafter referred to as 'SC/ST Act') has been filed by the appellant against the impugned order dated 12.05.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act-II)/Additional Judge, Pilibhit in Criminal Misc. Case No. 30 of 2020 (Rajeshwari Devi Vs.
Mukesh and another) as well as Final Report No. 73 of 2019 dated 21.09.2019 arising out of Case Rajeshwari Devi vs State Of U.P. And 8 Others on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59148049/
1 Crime No. 201 of 2019, under Sections 147, 452, 376, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Sections 3/4 of POCSO Act as well as Section 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act, Police Station-Barkheda, District-Pilibhit.
The main contention of learned counsel for the appellant is that the FIR was lodged on the basis of an application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C moved by the first informant.

sentences.text: During investigation merely after considering the natural facts of the witnesses, the final report has been submitted and on the basis of this report, the protest petition filed by the first informant has also been rejected.
From the perusal of the record, this Court finds that the victim is minor and in the statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she has supported the prosecution story.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, it is hereby directed that the Court concerned shall treat the aforesaid protest petition as a complaint case and the same may be decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
With the aforesaid directions, the appeal is disposed of.
